name: Jorge Rafael Videla
role: Argentine military ruler and de facto president (1976–1981)
summary: Videla defended military government, anti-communist repression and a Western Christian national identity. He favored private enterprise alongside strategic state development and rejected accountability for the junta’s crimes.
